hebrewText: וְ/רָאָה֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן אֹת֜/וֹ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔גַע וְ/לֹא פָשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖גַע בָּ/ע֑וֹר וְ/טִהֲר֤/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔יא וְ/כִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָהֵֽר

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
tokens.explanation: yom — dia, período de luz, era, tempo específico

tokens.bdb: seventh
tokens.kjv: seventh (time).

tokens.bdb: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
tokens.kjv: again, either (of them), (an-) other, second (time).

tokens.bdb: lo!
tokens.kjv: behold, lo, see.
tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: feeble, obscure
tokens.kjv: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

tokens.bdb: a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress)
tokens.kjv: plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to spread
tokens.kjv: spread.

tokens.bdb: a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress)
tokens.kjv: plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

tokens.bdb: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather
tokens.kjv: hide, leather, skin.

tokens.bdb: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
tokens.kjv: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: scruf (as spreading over the surface)
tokens.kjv: scab.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative
tokens.kjv: fuller, wash(-ing).

tokens.bdb: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
tokens.kjv: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

tokens.bdb: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
tokens.kjv: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).
